subject: english
stem: A cafe serves two coffees. What makes coffees countable here?
options: Coffee always becomes plural after two with no meaning change.
The word cafe changes every noun to countable.
Coffees means two coffee plants only.
It means two servings or cups of coffee.

optionRationales.reason: Coffee always becomes plural after two with no meaning change.：可數化來自份量語意。
The word cafe changes every noun to countable.：地點本身不提供此規則。
Coffees means two coffee plants only.：飲品服務語境不支持。
It means two servings or cups of coffee.：語境省略單位，指兩份飲品。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依語境中的可分單位、可直接計數性與量詞搭配，判斷名詞是可數、不可數或具雙重用法。」可推出 It means two servings or cups of coffee.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 It means two servings or cups of coffee. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
